newsitem.title: USA: Empire Blue Cross seeks for-profit status - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Empire Blue Cross seeks for-profit status - NYT.

text.p: Empire Blue Cross and Blue Shield said it plans to seek approval from regulators to convert to a for-profit insurer, the New York Times reported on Thursday.
Empire would create a charitable foundation, which would intially own 100 percent of the stock in the company.

The Empire foundation would sell all its holdings within five years, establishing a market value for the company that could be much higher than its current book value of $300 million, the article said.
The foundation would then issue more stock for sale to the public, the article said.
Empire Blue Cross will need approval from the New York State Insurance Department, the state attorney general's office, the state Supreme Court and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
